## CubingBC and Speedcubing Canada welcome you to BC Quiet Championship 2026!

### IMPORTANT NOTE 1: This competition is only hosting 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3x3 Multi-Blind.

For regular speedsolving events, please see
[BC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2026), or [other competitions in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=CA).

### IMPORTANT NOTE 2: If you are registered for the main BC Championship 2026, registration for this competition is FREE. In this case, please indicate in your registration comments that you are registered for both, and DO NOT pay the $20.00 registration fee. 

**Everybody is welcome to compete at the second-ever BC Championship!** Competitors from any country or region are invited to register, whether you’re a seasoned competitor or this is your very first competition. 

The highest placing British Columbia resident in each event will be recognized as the **2026 BC Champion**. Check out the [BC Champion Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCQuietChampionship2026#70680-bc-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition. All competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations prior to competing. If this is your first competition, please refer to the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCQuietChampionship2026#70679-faq-resources) tab for helpful tips.

---

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).
You are also welcome to join the Facebook group
[Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494).

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**.

You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon. **Please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

**Health and Safety:**
Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.
